newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in featureless trade, dealer said on Monday.
They said most traders were sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives.

"Rates were narrowly mixed in the morning on some position adjustments, amid uncertainty over market direction. Some people are waiting for fresh clues to market direction from Tuesday's release of the U.S. February housing starts figures," a local dealer said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday and Tuesday/Wednesday were unchanged from last Friday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent.
Week-fixed eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent.
Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent and three-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent.
Nine-months rose 1/16 point to 5-15/16 5-13/16 percent and twelve months rose 1/16 point to 6-1/16 5-15/16 percent.
